title: Unit 8: It's a Crime: Reported Speech
objective: Mampu melaporkan ucapan orang lain (reported speech), pertanyaan, permintaan, dan perintah dengan benar, serta memahami kosakata terkait kejahatan dan hukum

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara melaporkan ucapan orang lain (reported speech). Saat melaporkan, kita mengubah kalimat langsung menjadi kalimat tidak langsung dengan mengubah tenses, pronoun, dan time expressions. Reported speech digunakan untuk menyampaikan apa yang dikatakan, ditanya, atau diminta seseorang di masa lalu.
rules: Present Simple → Past Simple: She said, 'I like it' → She said (that) she liked it
Present Continuous → Past Continuous: 'I'm working' → He said he was working
Present Perfect → Past Perfect: 'I've finished' → She said she had finished
Past Simple → Past Perfect: 'I went' → He said he had gone
will → would: 'I will come' → She said she would come
can → could: 'I can help' → He said he could help
Reported Questions: 'Where do you live?' → He asked me where I lived (tanpa question mark)
Reported Requests: 'Please help me' → She asked me to help her
Reported Imperatives: 'Don't go!' → He told me not to go

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah tenses saat melaporkan ucapan, atau lupa mengubah time expressions seperti 'today' menjadi 'that day', 'yesterday' menjadi 'the day before'
commonTrap.wrong: She said she is tired today
commonTrap.correct: She said she was tired that day

readinessQuestions.prompt: Perhatikan kalimat langsung: "I like it". Bagaimana bentuk kalimat tidak langsung (reported/transformed) yang benar?
options: She say (that
She said (that
I like it
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kaidah pada "Reported Speech": bentuk yang tepat adalah "She said (that". Perhatikan perubahan tenses dan kata kerja bantunya.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang BENAR dan terhindar dari jebakan kesalahan umum pada topik "Reported Speech"?
options: She said she was tired that day
She said she is tired today
She said she were tired that day
readinessQuestions.explanation: Pemula sering lupa mengubah tenses saat melaporkan ucapan, atau lupa mengubah time expressions seperti 'today' menjadi 'that day', 'yesterday' menjadi 'the day before'

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
Reporter: "Mrs. Atkins, can you tell us what happened?"
Mrs. Atkins: "[...]"
options: She said she is tired today
When I went to ride my bike last Friday, I was shocked to discover it wasn't there.
Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "When I went to ride my bike last Friday, I was shocked to discover it wasn't there." ("Ketika saya hendak naik sepeda Jumat lalu, saya kaget menemukan sepeda itu tidak ada.") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Mrs. Atkins.

vocab.collocation: The burglar broke into the house at night
The mugger attacked someone in the street
The shoplifter was caught stealing from the store
Beware of pickpockets in crowded areas
The con man tricked people online
He was arrested for committing a crime
He got a fine for speeding
He was charged with embezzlement from the company

dialogue.context: Mrs. Atkins melaporkan kepada wartawan tentang sepedanya yang dicuri dan dikembalikan

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Mrs. Atkins, can you tell us what happened?
lines.translation: Bu Atkins, bisakah Anda ceritakan apa yang terjadi?

lines.speaker: Mrs. Atkins
lines.text: When I went to ride my bike last Friday, I was shocked to discover it wasn't there.
lines.translation: Ketika saya hendak naik sepeda Jumat lalu, saya kaget menemukan sepeda itu tidak ada.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Atkins
lines.text: I told the reporter that I'd been really angry when I realised the bike was gone.
lines.translation: Saya bilang ke wartawan bahwa saya sangat marah ketika menyadari sepeda itu hilang.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Atkins
lines.text: I decided to write a note to the thief and put it on the tree. To my surprise, the thief returned the bike with a written apology!
lines.translation: Saya memutuskan menulis surat untuk pencurinya dan menempelkannya di pohon. Yang mengejutkan, pencuri itu mengembalikan sepeda dengan surat permintaan maaf!

speakingLab.context: Simulasi melaporkan kejadian kejahatan kepada polisi atau wartawan

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I'm investigating a crime report. Can you tell me what happened yesterday?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I was walking home when someone stole my bag.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: I see. What did the thief look like? Can you describe them?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: He was wearing a green jacket and he ran very fast.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Did anyone else see what happened? What did they say?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: A woman told me that she had seen the same person near the station earlier.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good information! What will you do if we catch the thief?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I just want my bag back. I hope the police can find him soon.

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'I am feeling tired,' she said.
options: She said she is feeling tired
She said she was feeling tired
She said she has been feeling tired
quiz.answer: She said she was feeling tired
quiz.explanation: Present Continuous dalam direct speech berubah menjadi Past Continuous dalam reported speech

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'Where do you live?' he asked me.
options: He asked me where do I live
He asked me where I lived
He asked me where did I live
quiz.answer: He asked me where I lived
quiz.explanation: Reported questions tidak menggunakan question mark dan verb berubah ke past (do → did → lived)

quiz.question: What is a 'pickpocket'?
options: Someone who robs a bank
Someone who steals from people's pockets
Someone who breaks into houses
quiz.answer: Someone who steals from people's pockets
quiz.explanation: Pickpocket adalah pencopet yang mencuri barang dari saku orang

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'Don't go there!' she told him.
options: She told him don't go there
She told him not to go there
She told him to not go there
quiz.answer: She told him not to go there
quiz.explanation: Reported imperatives negatif menggunakan pola: told + object + not to + verb

quiz.question: What does 'to commit a crime' mean?
options: To prevent a crime
To do something illegal
To report a crime
quiz.explanation: 'Commit a crime' berarti melakukan tindakan kejahatan atau ilegal

quiz.question: Change to reported speech: 'I have finished my work,' he said.
options: He said he has finished his work
He said he had finished his work
He said he finished his work
quiz.answer: He said he had finished his work
quiz.explanation: Present Perfect dalam direct speech berubah menjadi Past Perfect (had finished) dalam reported speech
